title: Flying craft in ancient Indian texts

tellings.quote: Oh absolutely the Bhagavagita and the ancient themanas.

plain: Ancient Indian writings, among them the Bhagavad Gita, describe flying craft known as vimanas. A UFO activist named Steven Greer agrees with Michels on this without hesitation, "Oh absolutely," and names no particular passage or source. If so, people in ancient India were writing about machines in the sky long before modern UFO reports.
